decision.reason: [ev-33c3af75761f] says only "New logger for the Traefik logs" under Enhancements. It names no config key, flag, log format or output change, and gives no way to tell whether this is an added capability, a behaviour change under the same configuration, or a change to existing log settings. protocol-behavior (wire/protocol semantics) does not clearly fit an internal logger, and the validators are inconclusive. To decide subject and change, we need PR #9515 or the v3 migration notes describing any changed log format, settings or flags.
